jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer (AI Agents)
jobs.description: Your mission  Join our team and build the intelligent systems at the core of Cosuno's platform.    Generative AI: Build and improve our LLM-powered systems that navigate the complex, often messy tendering workflow.    Ship end-to-end into the product: Own features from model/agent through API to the TypeScript front-end — backend service, API, and the integration into the web app.    Collaborate across teams: Work with Product, Engineering, and Data to translate business problems into shipped AI features.    Maintain production AI: Monitoring, alerting, and continuous improvement of everything we deploy.      Your profile    TypeScript, React, Node: Non-negotiable. You're comfortable shipping into our web app end-to-end — front-end, backend service, API.    Strong Python: You have 5+ years writing production-grade Python. You write clean, well-structured code.    End-to-end product delivery: You've shipped AI-powered features into a production web app and owned the integration from research code to real users.    LLM application depth: You have deep hands-on experience building and deploying LLM/agent systems — RAG, tool use, multi-step reasoning, evals.    Backend engineering skills: You design APIs, data pipelines, and services.    Product mindset: You're comfortable with ambiguity and can judge when something is good enough to ship.    Sharp problem solver: You look at a complex system, quickly identify what matters, and decide what to do next.    Bias for action: When you're unsure something will work, your instinct is to find out with data rather than keep wondering.      How We Build: Our Engineering Culture  We believe in a calm, collaborative, and productive engineering environment. We trust our engineers and give them the autonomy to do their best work. Our approach includes:    Agile & Fast-Paced: We practice trunk-based development with daily releases to get value into our users' hands quickly.    Quality by Default: We maintain a comprehensive Cypress E2E test suite and enforce strict typing, linting, and formatting rules to keep our codebase clean and maintainable.    DevOps Mindset: Our well-oiled CI/CD pipeline deploys to AWS via Kubernetes, with our entire infrastructure managed as code using Terraform.    Collaboration & Transparency: We value open discussion, constructive code reviews, and a culture where the best idea wins, regardless of who it comes from.      Why us?    Competitive Compensation: A competitive salary above the market average.    Work-Life Balance: Choose to work 100% remotely or from our modern office in Berlin. We offer flexible working hours to fit your life.    Top-Notch Equipment: A new MacBook Pro to ensure you have the best tools for the job.    A Great Team: Regular company off-sites and team events that connect us as people, not just colleagues.    Job Security: A permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.      About us  Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.  We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.   Why Cosuno?   Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them avoid unnecessary costs.  But for us, it's not just about technology – it's about the people who drive it. At Cosuno, you will work with creative minds who are reshaping the construction industry. We believe in diversity because we know that the best ideas come from different perspectives. An integrative and inclusive work environment is a matter of course for us.   Join us – Build the future of construction.    Compensation: €90K – €120K    • €90K – €120K   Find  Jobs in Germany  on Arb

jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure DevOps Engineer (100% Remote Germany)
jobs.description:
Architect and scale the cloud platform behind a mission-critical SaaS product used globally. Own infrastructure strategy, reliability, and automation while influencing engineering at scale, reporting to the Cloud DevOps Team Leader. 
   About Innocraft & Matomo   
 Matomo is an open-source analytics platform trusted by enterprises, public institutions, and governments requiring full data ownership. 
  We’re looking for a Senior Infrastructure DevOps Engineer to take ownership of our cloud platform—driving architecture, reliability, and operational excellence at scale. 
   Why This Role   

 Own architecture and long-term evolution of a business-critical SaaS platform 
 Drive decisions that directly impact uptime, scalability, and security 
 High autonomy with real influence on engineering and platform direction 
 Stable, mature product with strong engineering foundations 
 Work cross-functionally across engineering, product, and security 

   What You'll Own   
  Platform Architecture & Strategy  

 Architect and evolve scalable, secure cloud infrastructure 
 Define infrastructure standards and long-term technical direction 
 Drive cost optimisation and performance improvements 

  Reliability & Operations  

 Own uptime, SLAs, and incident management practices 
 Lead post-incident reviews and systemic improvements 
 Define monitoring, alerting, and observability strategy    

  Automation & Engineering Enablement  

 Lead Infrastructure as Code maturity and governance 
 Improve CI/CD pipelines and deployment reliability 
 Enable engineering teams through better tooling and platform capabilities 

   What You'll Bring   
  Must-haves  

 5–8+ years in DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure engineering 
 Deep AWS and cloud architecture expertise 
 Strong Infrastructure as Code experience 
 Proven ownership of complex, production systems 
 Strong systems thinking and problem-solving ability 
 Ability to influence teams and drive technical decisions 

  Strong signals  

 Kubernetes and container platforms at scale 
 Experience with high-availability SaaS products 
 Exposure to compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2) 
 Experience mentoring engineers and shaping practices 

   Benefits   

 100% remote role  (Must be based in Germany)  
  30 days paid holiday + national public holidays 
 Remote office budget + home equipment supplied 
 Health insurance, mental health support and a volunteering day 
 Annual learning budget  

   Location   100% remote — Germany only.    Career Trajectory   Within 12–24 months, you will expand ownership across platform architecture, influence company-wide engineering practices, and progress toward Staff/Principal-level leadership with broader technical direction and mentorship scope.   Diversity & Inclusion    
 InnoCraft (trading as Matomo) values what makes you unique. We’re an inclusive employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, because diverse perspectives help us build better products. 
 #LI-Remote
